# Structure of the game's getdown.txt with invented hosts; only what launching needs.
version = 20000101000000
appbase = http://example.invalid/spiral/%VERSION%
latest = http://example.invalid/spiral/latest/getdown.txt

# These all go into the classpath
code = code/config.jar
code = code/projectx-config.jar
code = code/projectx-pcode.jar
code = code/lwjgl.jar
code = [linux] code/lwjgl-natives-linux.jar
code = [mac os x] code/lwjgl-natives-macos.jar
code = [mac os x] code/lwjgl-natives-macos-arm64.jar
code = [windows] code/lwjgl-natives-windows.jar
code = code/commons-logging.jar

resource = code/getdown-pro-new.jar
resource = [linux] native/libsteam_api.so
resource = [windows] native/steam_api64.dll
resource = [mac os x] native/libsteam_api.dylib
uresource = rsrc/intro-bundle.jar
auxgroups = full
full.uresource = rsrc/full-rest-bundle.jar

java_version = 25000000
java_location = [windows] /spiral/client/java_windows.jar
java_location = [linux] /spiral/client/java_linux.jar
java_location = [mac os x] /spiral/client/java_macos.jar

# Parameters passed to the JVM
jvmarg = -Djava.library.path=%APPDIR%/native
jvmarg = -Dorg.lwjgl.util.NoChecks=true
jvmarg = -Dappdir=%APPDIR%
jvmarg = -Dresource_dir=%APPDIR%/rsrc
jvmarg = -XX:-CreateCoredumpOnCrash
jvmarg = --add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED
jvmarg = --add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED
jvmarg = --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED
jvmarg = -Dcrucible.dir=../crucible
jvmarg = [mac os x] -Djdk.lang.Process.launchMechanism=FORK

# The main Java class
class = com.threerings.projectx.client.ProjectXApp
client.class = com.threerings.projectx.client.ProjectXApp

uresource = crucible.jar
crucible-editor.class = com.threerings.projectx.tools.CrucibleSceneEditor

ui.name = Spiral Knights
ui.mac_dock_icon = rsrc/ui/icon/desktop.icns
